cover.tagline: SELECTABLE POWER. SELECTABLE CCT. YOKE OR SLIP-FITTER.
cover.positioning: A die-cast flood for building, sign and site lighting. Power and colour temperature are set in the field, and the same fixture ships on a yoke or a slip-fitter. For custom solutions please contact our sales representative.

quality_line: ADC12 die-cast aluminium with integrated fins, IP65 with a drainage groove, wet-location rated.
description: The Selectable Floodlight is a die-cast aluminium flood for building, sign and site lighting. Power (40, 60 or 80W) and colour temperature (3000, 4000 or 5000K) are set on switches under a rear cover, so one fixture covers several designs. It runs on 120-277VAC with 0-10V dimming, is IP65 and wet-location rated, and mounts on a yoke or a slip-fitter (pole up to 2-3/8 in, aiming 0-90 deg). On a 480V circuit it needs a step-down transformer to 277V.
overview_add: Input: 120-277VAC only. A 480V circuit needs a step-down transformer to 277V.
